summary: Intelligence gains recurring Intel from accumulated Operation Progress and may use a qualifying Mission or Special Operation Action during Denouement after using its normal Action during Opening.

turnStartIntel.timing: At the start of your turn
turnStartIntel.effect: Gain Intel equal to your Operation Progress.

operationalCapacity.name: Operational Capacity
operationalCapacity.rule: If you used your normal Action during Opening, you may still spend 1 Action during Denouement to Start or Complete a Mission or Special Operation. You still cannot take more than one Action in either phase.
operationalCapacity.note: Mission and Special Operation procedures remain 1 Action Faction Features. Operational Capacity supplies only the cross-phase permission needed for one qualifying Denouement Action after an Opening Action; it is not a free Action and cannot be converted into a second ordinary Denouement Action.

operationProgressSemantics.normalMissionChange: +1 each time a normal Mission is completed
operationProgressSemantics.meaning: Operation Progress tracks how many normal Missions the Intelligence player has completed.
operationProgressSemantics.note: The +1 Operation Progress from completing a Mission is not an additional payment or resource reward; it records completed-Mission progress. The recurring Intel rule makes that accumulated progress determine baseline Intel generation on later turns.

missionCompletion.immediateIntelUnchanged: A completed normal Mission still grants Intel equal to that Mission card's value.
missionCompletion.operationProgressUnchanged: Completing a normal Mission still increments Operation Progress by 1.
missionCompletion.timingConsequence: The newly increased Operation Progress does not retroactively generate Intel on Mission completion. It contributes to the next and later start-of-turn Intel gains.

specialOperations.note: Special Operation readiness, completion cost, and victory procedure are otherwise unchanged.
